brief: A ramp for my cat to walk up to the windowsill.

requirements.evidence: piece:2,0,0;full + cover:2,0,0;full;top (80mm), piece:1,0,1;full + cover:1,0,1;full;top (160mm), piece:0,0,2;full + cover:0,0,2;full;top (240mm) — three walkable steps in a run
three storeys rising 80mm per storey to 240mm top; place against windowsill so top cover meets sill

finish.summary: Built a 3-step stepped ramp (6 full bases in a line stepping up one storey at a time) with solid top covers on each step, open faces capped and joints locked. Place the tall end against the windowsill so the cat can walk up the low-medium-high steps.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
